# Test fixtures

- `standard/`: copy of the MOSAIC standard published by mosaic-catalog (`dist/schema`, `dist/vocab`,
  `dist/crosswalks`, `manifest.json` without its record list), v0.1.0.
- `mosaic/`: four MOSAIC records (079, 090, 104, 064) from mosaic-catalog `dist/catalog.json`, with
  their manifest entries.
- `cdh/records/`: three records from CGIAR Climate Data Hub `cdh-catalog` (commit 18e5333,
  2026-10-27), used unchanged under that repository's Apache License 2.0.
